answer: Use a vouching ladder: a new agent enters with a small refundable stake and climbs a spiral staircase of trust, each step requiring a vouch from an already established agent who stakes part of its own reputation. Only after several independent vouches does the agent reach the flat mesa of full privileges. Misbehavior slashes both the newcomer and every voucher, so an attacker must buy real stakes and corrupt several honest agents at once, while honest newcomers climb a narrow ridge of accountability that costs attackers far more than it costs them.
